basic_details.job_title: ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: A walk-in interview for 1 post of Part Time Medical Officer will be held at 2.00 PM on 4 December 2026 (Friday) at the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.). Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University (ANGRAU), Agricultural College :: Naira, is filling the post on contract (temporary) basis for a period of 11 months, with an honorarium of Rs.35,000/- per month for candidates holding an M.B.B.S.

content_sections.heading: About ANGRAU Part Time Medical officer
content_sections.text: The notice is issued by Agricultural College :: Naira of Acharya N.G. Ranga Agricultural University, under Cir. Memo. No.A1/Part Time Doctor/ACN/2026 dated 20 November 2026. The Part Time Medical Officer will work in the Health Clinic, Agricultural College, Naira – 532 185, in Srikakulam district.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: Only one post is advertised: Part Time Medical Officer on temporary basis, 01 No. (One only), in the Health Clinic of Agricultural College, Naira. The pay is Rs.35,000/- per month, described in the notice as an honorarium. The essential qualifications printed in the notice are: M.B.B.S Experience in working at notified Colleges/Hostels is highly desirable The notice lists the experience under "Essential Qualifications" but calls it "highly desirable", so the M.B.B.S is the qualification that is required. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates may check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Terms and Conditions of the Engagement
content_sections.text: The post is on contract basis (temporary basis) for a period of 11 months. The duration is 11 months from the date of joining or filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier. The individual is engaged purely on temporary and contractual basis, and the engagement will be terminated after completion of 11 months or filling of regular staff, whichever is earlier. The incumbent shall not have any claim or any right to claim for any regular appointment in the University or any government organisation. The incumbent shall not have any claim or any right for further continuation of contractual service.

faq.question: Q1. When is the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 4 December 2026 (Friday) at 2.00 PM.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira, Srikakulam (Dist.).

faq.question: Q3. How many Part Time Medical Officer vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 01 post (One only) of Part Time Medical Officer in the Health Clinic, Agricultural College, Naira.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is needed for the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer post?
faq.answer: The notice requires an M.B.B.S. Experience in working at notified Colleges/Hostels is highly desirable.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The post carries Rs.35,000/- per month as honorarium.

faq.question: Q6. Is the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The engagement is purely temporary and contractual, and the incumbent shall not have any claim or right to regular appointment in the University or any government organisation.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the ANGRAU Part Time Medical Officer contract?
faq.answer: The contract is for 11 months from the date of joining or until filling of the regular post, whichever is earlier, and gives no right to further continuation of contractual service.

faq.question: Q8. How can I contact the office about the ANGRAU walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The notice gives the e-mail [email protected] and the mobile number 7673902146 for the Office of the Associate Dean, Agricultural College, Naira.
